ask-user.name: Ask user
ask-user.desc: Put open questions to the user and wait for a decision.

delivery-gate.name: Delivery gate
delivery-gate.desc: Combine checks, tests, and the verdict into one route.

failure-triage.name: Failure triage
failure-triage.desc: Name the single smallest cause of a failure and the minimal fix.

handoff-brief.name: Handoff brief
handoff-brief.desc: Close the run with an evidence-backed brief.

meeting-intake.name: Meeting intake
meeting-intake.desc: Resolve which meeting is meant and load its transcript and notes.

pr-staging.name: PR staging
pr-staging.desc: Commit, push the branch, and open a PR to the base branch.

project-checks.name: Project checks
project-checks.desc: Run typecheck, lint, and build separately and report each result.

repo-orientation.name: Repository orientation
repo-orientation.desc: Learn the conventions and name the surface the change touches.

repo-target.name: Repository target
repo-target.desc: Decide which repository and base branch the change belongs to.

request-extraction.name: Request extraction
request-extraction.desc: Extract the change a named person actually asked for, with quotes.

request-verification.name: Request verification
request-verification.desc: Judge the diff against what the meeting actually asked for.

scoped-implementation.name: Scoped implementation
scoped-implementation.desc: Implement exactly the planned change and nothing adjacent.

targeted-repair.name: Targeted repair
targeted-repair.desc: Apply only the minimal fix that triage named.

test-suite.name: Test suite
test-suite.desc: Run the tests covering the change, then the full suite.

workspace-safety.name: Workspace safety
workspace-safety.desc: Preserve uncommitted work and open a clean working branch.

meeting-request.name: Meeting request
meeting-request.desc: Turn "what X said in the meeting" into one attributed, unambiguous change request.

pr-handoff.name: PR handoff
pr-handoff.desc: Open the PR against the base branch and hand back an evidence-backed brief.

repo-preflight.name: Repository preflight
repo-preflight.desc: Choose the repository, preserve uncommitted work, branch, and learn the conventions.

verify-and-repair.name: Verify and repair
verify-and-repair.desc: Run every check independently and route each failure to one minimal, bounded repair.
